description: This PHP class defines a data transfer object (DTO) 'EmployeeLeaveBalanceSearchFilterParams' used for filtering employee leave balance search results. It extends another filter parameters class and incorporates a date range trait, with a focus on an employee number property.

classes.name: EmployeeLeaveBalanceSearchFilterParams
classes.description: A DTO class for employee leave balance search filter parameters, extending LeaveTypeSearchFilterParams and using a date range trait, primarily managing an employee number property.

methods.name: getEmpNumber
methods.description: Returns the employee number associated with the filter.

methods.name: setEmpNumber
methods.description: Sets the employee number for the filter parameter.
